connector.name: Kubernetes Ephemeral Job
connector.registryDescription: Runs a command in a throwaway Kubernetes pod and returns exit code, output and artifacts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-k8s-ephemeral-job:v0.7.1. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the inhuman account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MCP_K8S_ALLOWED_IMAGES
env.description: Strict image allowlist (CSV). Empty means every call is rejected, so this must be set.

env.name: MCP_K8S_KUBECONFIG
env.description: Path to the kubeconfig inside the container. Empty = use in-cluster credentials.

env.name: MCP_K8S_NAMESPACE
env.description: Namespace the ephemeral pods are created in. Needs a Role/RoleBinding for jobs and pods.

env.name: MCP_K8S_TRANSPORT
env.description: MCP transport: stdio | http | sse. Must be 'stdio' for direct docker/stdio use.

env.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S
env.description: Default wall-clock timeout per job, seconds.

env.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_TIMEOUT_S
env.description: Maximum wall-clock timeout a caller may request, seconds.

env.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
env.description: Cap on combined stdout/stderr before truncation.

env.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES
env.description: Cap on the total size of returned artifacts.

env.name: MCP_K8S_MAX_CONCURRENT
env.description: Maximum ephemeral pods running at the same time.

env.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_CPU
env.description: Pod CPU request; limits come from the caller or the namespace LimitRange.

env.name: MCP_K8S_DEFAULT_MEMORY
env.description: Pod memory request; limits come from the caller or the namespace LimitRange.

env.name: MCP_K8S_SIDECAR_IMAGE
env.description: Helper image used to inject input files and collect artifacts.

env.name: MCP_K8S_CLONE_IMAGE
env.description: Image carrying git for the clone init container. Empty disables the clone field.

env.name: MCP_K8S_CLONE_SECRET
env.description: Secret with git tokens, mounted only on the cloner. Empty disables the clone field.

env.name: MCP_K8S_CACHE_PVC
env.description: Existing PVC mounted into every job pod as a shared cache. Empty = no cache.

env.name: MCP_K8S_CACHE_MOUNT_PATH
env.description: Where the cache PVC is mounted, e.g. /go/pkg/mod. Empty = no cache.

env.name: MCP_K8S_JOB_EXTRA_ENV
env.description: JSON object of env vars added to every job pod; caller keys win on collision.

env.name: MCP_K8S_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Optional X-MCP-AUTH token required on every request (http/sse transports only).
